overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Plate
boxes.derivation: A 40' bottom plate lies flat: 480" (491520 units) across X, 3 1/2" up Y, 1 1/2" thick. Occupies x 0..480, y 0..3 1/2, z 0..1 1/2.

boxes.name: Shim
boxes.derivation: A 6" x 3 1/2" shim, 1/32" (32 units) thick, on the plate's top face at mid-span: x 237..243, z 1 1/2..1 17/32.

boxes.name: Wall
boxes.derivation: The wall itself (a thing built, not a part: part is null) stands on the shim's top at 1 17/32", 96" tall: z 1 17/32..97 17/32. (49/32 = 1.53125).

cutList.label: Shim
cutList.derivation: 6" x 3 1/2" x 1/32" = 6144 x 3584 x 32 units. 1/32" is half a sixteenth, so the thickness reads 1/16 (half away from zero), marked approx. The wall has no part and no row.
